_note: SvelteKit route scripts get every typing upstream's `upsertKitFile` injects: `export const actions` carries `satisfies import('./$types.js').Actions` (so an action's event is contextually typed and a wrong return is reported), a parameterless `entries` gets `ReturnType<EntryGenerator>` as its return type, and a `+server` file receives the page-option (`prerender`, `trailingSlash`, …) and `entries` typing in addition to its HTTP handlers. Before, `actions` and `entries` were untyped (TS7031 on every action's destructured event; wrong shapes unchecked) and `+server` page options were never typed. Shape and positions were verified against upstream on a real SvelteKit app; the `$types.d.ts` files here are stand-ins for `svelte-kit sync`'s output.
